title: Audit complete retimed and delayed supplier words
body:
## Summary

Answer [PR3687 Open question2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f798838eb8ede4178e94f240e7b7e54b3f80c82d/research/staged-644-660-independent-audit/README.md#open-next-questions) with a source-bound, reproducible whole-word cross-check of the RETIMED words in PR3642/PR3653 and the separately serialized DELAYED words in PR3682, against their STAGED control. All six words pass with 632 independent live inputs and 91 independently dirty buffers: complete forward/dual endpoint contracts, all 723-register forward/reverse pull-back coefficients, and the cleanup boundary agree exactly.

This **reuses Sagar Thakrar's unchanged PR3687 interpreter**, including its explicit Arham Tahir contract/frame-audit lineage. It is not a new interpreter or the first independent retiming proof. PR3642 already proves its local commuting swaps and cleanup reordering; PR3682 independently reconstructs its moves and proves arbitrary-dirty operator equivalence. Sagar also reported an unshipped RETIMED forward/dual/frame scratch check. This package adds committed direct whole-word computation through that evaluator, including the reverse pull-back and DELAYED words, with meaningful failure controls.

- Complete reconstructed JSON equals each published changed word. Both changed profiles are `{1:2437,2:724,3:226,4:102,5:20,8:8}`, with unchanged widths and rank mass 5135. Each donor 640/656 has delta `{1:-1,2:-1,3:+1}`; no other register invoice changes.
- All 36 required-outcome controls behave as specified. Omitted, sign-flipped or over-delayed releases fail the actual symbolic endpoint after regenerating cleanup. Old cleanup remains **semantically valid** but fails literal canonical order. Old release frames preserve the operator but restore the STAGED bill in RETIMED and violate containment in DELAYED. A false declared profile is rejected.
- Six exact compressed word inputs and the original evaluator are retained (~0.5MB total package). Nine unique source mappings, fixed source commits, SHA256 and Git blob IDs are checked before source execution. No foreign Git objects or construction/native code are needed by the direct replay.

Exact heads: PR3605 `3efbb5de`, PR3642 `044d24f1`, PR3653 `607a09ff`, PR3682 `431e6c60`, PR3687 `f798838e`. Credit Ross Richardson, roger-sato, Rohan Arun, zxv and Sagar Thakrar respectively, plus Arham Tahir, dcharb78/PR3133, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Jeremy Kothe and the preserved word lineage. Source paths/full commits and the existing coverage are in the package README/SOURCES.

Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The independent-moment card is refined to this explicit descendant-word handoff. Fresh open/closed PR and Discussion overlap includes the published local proofs, PR3677 histogram arithmetic and PR3681 inherited full replay; none is described as a first-proof gap.

## Test plan

- [x] CPython 3.12.14, macOS 27 arm64: complete result generation passed in 11.58s; direct Git-free copied-package replay passed in 11.30s.
- [x] All 36 semantic/format controls are recomputed with the positive words, not accepted from stored PASS summaries. RESULT.json is compared to freshly computed findings.
- [x] Sixteen bounded authentication checks pass normally/under `-O`: positive control and rejected missing core, missing word, duplicate/extra mapping, wrong commit, changed core and changed word bytes. The exact retained evaluator and all 9 source mappings were independently authenticated against their original Git/API bytes.
- [x] Committed-byte preflight passes for all 13 files at `eb1ecb9e7cc85b4fa8c00eba97dbf8feee9b48b2`. The separate full-history check confirms the declared canonical source is in publication ancestry; all foreign word/evaluator bytes are retained and independently authenticated.
- [x] Independent final review passed. The registered normal/optimized pair completed in 22.78s with `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `outcome=completed`, reproducing all six words and 36 controls in each mode. No hosted-CI or complete supplier acceptance is inferred from these local checks.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/retimed-word-independent-audit
# Direct, also usable outside Git after copying this package:
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/retimed-word-independent-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/retimed-word-independent-audit/verify.py
```

This is finite operator/frame evidence only. It supplies no new kappa, selected-frontier change, native Gaussian phase certificate, consumer owner/window proof, root audit, whole-wrapper replay or all-size multiplication theorem. Those obligations remain explicit, including PR3687 OQ1's shared entrance residual. Frozen packages and production helpers are unchanged.

Prepared by roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for investigation, implementation, execution, independent agent review and writing; reviewed 2026-10-19 JST. No human or formal-kernel verification claimed. Apache-2.0.


Hosted follow-up (2026-10-19 JST): the [fork Registered research packages run](https://github.com/roger-sato/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39141018220) **passes** at exact head `eb1ecb9e7cc85b4fa8c00eba97dbf8feee9b48b2` on Ubuntu 24.04 / CPython 3.12.15. The 265 onboarding-helper tests pass (11 platform skips); selection from canonical base `20ecf289` contains only this package. Both registered normal/optimized commands emit `PASS_RETIMED_AND_DELAYED_WHOLE_WORD_AUDIT`, the runner reports `outcome=completed`, and the committed-input immutability check passes. This corroborates the local finite audit; it does not establish native supplier acceptance or any broader scientific claim. Upstream pull-request Actions still require maintainer approval.
